profile.headline: Software Engineer at Public Strategies
profile.summary: Software Engineer currently focusing on React front-end UI development, but passionate about the full stack.

positions.title: Back End Engineer
positions.description:
Nottingham - Stock Trading Purchase Module
Javascript | React.js | Node.js | PostgreSQL | Express | Nginx | AWS

▪ Designed and implemented a schema and database for web-scale traffic for an existing microservice capable of efficiently querying 10 million data points
▪ Optimized service throughput by implementing an Nginx load balancer increasing RPS from 180 to 1150(+640%) and decreased latency from 49ms to 21ms(-60%) while maintaining a 0% error rate

FreeSeats - Restaurant Reservation Full-Stack Application
Javascript | Node.js | React.js | CSS | Express | MySQL | Docker | AWS

▪ Build React.js photo carousel module to allow dynamic visualization based on component implementation context
▪ Utilized agile best practices and daily team standups to consistently meet and surpass timetable expectations
